verdict.rationale: Blink's source is publicly hosted on GitHub (blinksh/blink), and the repo invites users to download and build it themselves via Xcode. A community member also credits Blink's open source development process. The core of the story, reading the source, is clearly met, but no evidence names the license. Missing for 10: explicit identification of the open-source license (e.g., GPL/MIT text or LICENSE file), and documentation confirming which parts of the shipped app are covered by that license.
